content5.ptxt: The driver side knee airbag squib circuit consists of the airbag computer assembly and instrument panel lower airbag No.1. This circuit commands SRS deployment when the deployment conditions are met. These DTCs are recorded in the airbag computer assembly when a malfunction is detected in the driver side knee airbag squib circuit.

test1.ptxt: Disconnect the battery negative terminal and wait for at least 90 seconds.

atten4.ptxt: Make sure the ignition switch is OFF before disconnecting the cable from the negative (-) battery terminal.

test1.ptxt: Check the connection condition of the connectors connected to the airbag computer assembly and instrument panel lower airbag No.1.
Disconnect the connectors from the airbag computer assembly and instrument panel lower airbag No.1, and check the condition of the terminals of each connector.

specitem.ptxt: The terminals are not deformed or damaged

specitem.ptxt: The short pins are not deformed or damaged

testgrp.testtitle: Driver Side Knee Airbag Squib Circuit Inspection (Between Airbag Computer Assembly and Instrument Panel No.1)

atten4.ptxt: For the inspection procedure and precautions, refer to

test1.ptxt: Connect the battery negative terminal and wait for at least 2 seconds.
Turn IG ON.
Using SST (Toyota electrical tester), measure the voltage between each terminal of connector C and body ground.
Turn IG OFF.
Disconnect the battery negative terminal and wait for at least 90 seconds.
Using SST (Toyota electrical tester), measure the resistance between the terminals of connector C.
Release the activation prevention mechanism of connector B [1-9 (DK+), 1-10 (DK-)].
Using SST (Toyota electrical tester), measure the resistance between the terminals of connector C.
Using SST (Toyota electrical tester), measure the resistance between each terminal of connector C and body ground.

testgrp.testtitle: Inspect Instrument Panel Airbag Assembly Lower NO.1

test1.ptxt: Connect the airbag computer assembly connector.
Connect the battery negative terminal and wait for at least 2 seconds.
Turn the IG ON and wait for at least 60 seconds.
Using SST (TaSCAN), clear the DTCs. (see )
Turn IG OFF.
Turn the IG ON and wait for at least 60 seconds.
Using SST (TaSCAN), check the DTCs. (see )

entry.ptxt: DTCs other than B1861 are output

test1.ptxt: Turn IG OFF.
Disconnect the battery negative terminal and wait for at least 90 seconds.
Connect the instrument panel lower airbag No.1 connector.
Connect the battery negative terminal and wait for at least 2 seconds.
Turn the IG ON and wait for at least 60 seconds.
Using SST (TaSCAN), clear the DTCs (see ).
Turn IG OFF.
Turn the IG ON and wait for at least 60 seconds.
Using SST (TaSCAN), check for DTCs (see ).

entry.ptxt: DTCs B1860, B1861, B1862 and B1863 are not output.
DTCs B1860, B1861, B1862 and B1863 are output.

atten4.ptxt: DTCs other than B1860, B1861, B1862 and B1863 may be output, but they are not related to this inspection.
